exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Kelvin sense: the 50 uOhm part is listed only as AE-5.0 with no sense hole (BAS p2 dimension table, read 2026-10-02T17:45:03Z); no wired-sense version in the datasheet
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The requirement is 'defined sense points for the leads'; a sense hole is not a requirement value. The BAS datasheet (Issue 08-September-2026, https://www.isabellenhuette.com/hubfs/Files/Data-sheets/BAS.pdf, fetched 2026-10-02T18:16:34Z) page 2 'Connection diagram' (Z-DR-159a) is drawn for the BAS series, not for the R version only: it marks 'position sense connection for flexible wires' on the copper strips each side of the resistive element and a 'soldering area for pcb', with the voltmeter U across those two strips. Only the R version adds the D2 hole on top. So the AE-5.0 versions have defined sense points. Values on P2's own basis (terminal 50 degC, as for BAS-M-R0001-R-5.0): BAS-M-R00005 is 50 uOhm, Manganin, Rthi 1.5 K/W, TCR 0 +/-100 ppm/K (20 to 60 degC), EMF 0.6 uV/K, 36 W at 70 degC terminal: at 300 A it dissipates 4.5 W, element 56.75 degC, TCR term 100 ppm x 300 A x 31.75 K = 0.953 A, EMF 0.6 uV/K x 6.75 K / 50 uOhm = 81 mA, total 1.03 A against 2.816 A; at 15 A 37.5 mA against 108.8 mA. Digi-Key (cached readings of 2026-10-02T14:23:29Z, vendors.py digikey, ProductStatus Active): BAS-M-R00005-AE-5.0 stock 863, 18 weeks; -AEU-5.0 stock 161, 41 weeks; -EU, -GU, -SU stock 0 and fail Rule 4. The datasheet's TCR range (20 to 60 degC only) is the same limitation P2 records for the BAS-M-R0001-R-5.0. 50 uOhm nominal is the bottom of the 50 to 136 uOhm class; as made, minus 5 % is 47.5 uOhm.

Both are in the BAS dimension table and share the page 2 Connection diagram (Z-DR-159a, 'position sense connection for flexible wires', 'soldering area for pcb') with the R version P2 ranks second, so their sense points are defined and 'no sense hole' is not a requirement value. Same element, Rthi 2 K/W, TCR 0 +/-50 ppm/K and EMF as the BAS-M-R0001-R-5.0, so P2's figure for that part (753 mA of 2.833 A at 300 A, 19.0 mA at 15 A, terminal at 50 degC) applies. The E version has the shortest lead time of the BAS parts read (12 weeks against 18 for the R). The remaining codes stand for other reasons: EU, G, Z, A05, A07 read 0 at Digi-Key (13:58:58Z, Rule 4); ABU (207, 18 weeks) is not in the datasheet's version table and its sense arrangement is not shown, so it stays dropped.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Accuracy share not shown: TCR +/-175 ppm/degC for 50 uOhm (30411, revision 26-May-2026) gives 65.6 mA at 15 A but the sheet states no element-to-terminal thermal resistance for 50 uOhm, so the share at 300 A is not bounded from the datasheet
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: P2 passes the 100 uOhm WSBS8536L1000JK60 of the same sheet on 2 K/W and 18 K (2668.5 mA of 2.833 A), and that figure also comes from the same sheet's rating: all values of WSBS8536...60 are rated 50 W at 70 degC with a derating to +170 degC, which gives (170-70)/50 = 2 K/W for every value. On P2's own basis (terminal 50 degC) the 50 uOhm part at 300 A is 4.5 W, 9 K, element 59 degC: TCR 175 ppm x 300 A x 34 K = 1.785 A plus EMF 3 uV/degC x 9 K / 50 uOhm = 540 mA, total 2.325 A against 2.816 A (491 mA margin, more than the 164.5 mA of the 100 uOhm part P2 passes); at 15 A 65.6 mA against 108.8 mA. The accuracy reason therefore does not hold. The part is still not a candidate: vendors.py digikey WSBS8536L0500JK60 answered HTTP 404 'Requested Product wsbs8536l0500jk60 Not Found' (2026-10-02T18:08:49Z) and the keyword search 'WSBS8536' (cached 2026-10-02T13:59:00Z) lists no L0500 part with the sense-pin code 60 or 80; the 50 uOhm sense-pin parts it lists are L0500JK20 (49, one under the gate of 50) and L0500JK40 (0). The drop stands on Rule 4, not on accuracy.
